# Where the Horse Sweats

*Wystan wants to know what the patrol horses smell out there. Ride the road past Downs Edge and note where a horse starts to sweat, then hunt 25 downs boars on the Thyme Banks, where the smell leads.*

## Objectives

1. Reach [Downs Edge](../maps/downs_edge.md)
2. Defeat 25 [Downs Boar](../monsters/downs_boar.md) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)

- 3,200 EXP
- 420 mesos
